Comparison

Claude vs Gemini

A side-by-side look at Claude and Gemini, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose Claude when your priority is: long-document analysis, careful professional writing, and agentic coding across a whole codebase. Choose Gemini when your priority is: anyone already inside Google Workspace/Drive who wants AI where their files already live.

Claude vs Gemini at a glance

CriteriaClaudeGemini
CategoryAI ChatbotsAI Chatbots
Best forLong-document analysis, careful professional writing, and agentic coding across a whole codebase.Anyone already inside Google Workspace/Drive who wants AI where their files already live.
Pricing modelFreemiumFreemium
Free planYesYes
Free trialNoNo
API availableYesYes
Platforms
  • Web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android
  • Claude Code (terminal, VS Code, JetBrains)
  • Chrome extension
  • Excel/PowerPoint add-ins
  • Slack
  • Web, Android (deep OS integration), iOS, Chrome, Workspace apps (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Slides, Meet)
Key features
  • Very long context windows (200K up to 1M tokens)
  • Artifacts (live documents, code and apps in-chat)
  • Projects with shared knowledge
  • Research mode
  • Claude Code CLI and IDE agent
  • Cowork agentic desktop app
  • Gemini 3.x model family with 1M-token context
  • Deep Research
  • Veo video generation and Flow editor
  • Deep Think reasoning on top tiers
  • Gemini Spark background agent
  • Antigravity agentic dev platform
Advantages
  • Best-in-class long context
  • very strong instruction following and writing quality
  • Artifacts and file creation produce usable deliverables, not just text
  • Team/Enterprise exclude training at contract level
  • Unmatched bundle value - 5 TB storage plus YouTube Premium Lite at the $19.99 tier
  • native Workspace integration
  • 1M-token context standard
  • strongest consumer video generation via Veo.
Limitations
  • Session and weekly caps can bite hard during agentic coding
  • image generation is not native
  • smaller plugin ecosystem than ChatGPT
  • Anthropic's own pages have at times been inconsistent about annual Max pricing.
  • Plan names 'AI Plus' vs 'AI Pro' are easy to confuse
  • compute-based quotas are opaque
  • some Ultra features are US-only (Gemini Spark) or locked to the $199.99 tier (Project Genie)
  • pricing restructured twice in 2026.

Pricing notes

Claude

Free $0. Pro $20/mo or $200/yr (~$17/mo effective). Max in two tiers: $100/mo (5x Pro) and $200/mo (20x Pro). Team from $25/seat/mo (about $20/seat annual) for standard seats, with a higher premium seat tier. Enterprise custom. Education plans for institutions. API separate: Fable 5.1 $10/$50 per 1M in/out tokens, Opus 5 $5/$25, Sonnet 5 $2/$10, Haiku 4.5 $1/$5.

Gemini

Free $0. Google AI Plus $4.99/mo (cut from $7.99 on 8 June 2026; 400 GB storage, 2x free limits). Google AI Pro $19.99/mo (4x limits, 5 TB storage, YouTube Premium Lite, Google Home Premium, 1,000 Flow credits). Google AI Ultra in two tiers since I/O 2026: $99.99/mo (5x Pro, 20 TB) and $199.99/mo (20x Pro, reduced from $249.99; adds Project Genie). Annual billing now available on every paid plan. Gemini is bundled into Workspace Business Standard/Plus/Enterprise - the standalone Workspace add-on was dropped in 2025.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: Claude ↗ · Gemini ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between Claude and Gemini?

Claude: Conversational assistant from Anthropic focused on long-context reasoning, careful writing, document analysis and agentic coding. Gemini: Google's multimodal assistant, sold through the Google AI consumer subscription ladder (formerly 'Gemini Advanced') and bundled into Google Workspace.

When should I choose Claude over Gemini?

Claude is listed as best for: long-document analysis, careful professional writing, and agentic coding across a whole codebase. Gemini is listed as best for: anyone already inside Google Workspace/Drive who wants AI where their files already live.

Do Claude and Gemini have a free plan?

Claude: Yes. Gemini: Yes. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
